result:
I've finished the role-change feature and was just moving the success notification into the API hook. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **API hook** (`features/users/api/update-user-role.ts`): sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`. On success it invalidates the `['users']` query so the list shows the new role. It also shows the "User Role Updated" notification here, because `features/CLAUDE.md` says success notifications belong in the `api/` hook and not in components.
- **Role select** (`features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx`): a plain `<select>` with Admin and User options. It is disabled while the request is pending.
- **Users table** (`users-list.tsx`): the Role column now renders that select.
- **Mock API** (`testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`): I added an MSW handler for the new endpoint. It requires an admin and only updates users in the caller's team.

I used a plain `<select>` because the existing `Select` in `components/ui/form` only works with react-hook-form registration.

I haven't checked how the users page is protected, so I don't know if it's already admin-only. Only the mock handler enforces admin on the role change.
